subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supplier Audits
description: A short lesson to help you apply Supplier Audits.

hook.text: A brand discovers its supplier subcontracted to a factory using child labor. The brand name is now toxic.

buildup.text: Supplier audits are on-site inspections that verify quality systems, labor practices, and compliance.

discovery.text: Auditors check documentation, interview workers, inspect equipment, and review safety records firsthand.

twist.text: Some suppliers prepare specifically for audits, hiding violations. Unannounced visits reveal the real picture.

climax.text: Regular audits protect brand reputation, ensure quality, and verify that ethical standards are met.

punchline.text: Trust but verify. Visit the factory yourself.

quiz.question: Why are unannounced audits more effective?
options: They reveal real conditions, not rehearsed ones
